title: DFIR-Metric: A Benchmark Dataset for Evaluating Large Language Models in Digital Forensics and Incident Response
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical proficiency of LLMs in the domain of Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR).
